text_block_list.text:
Heheh, it's finally time! My hands are itching for action!
Feels like every hair on my body is standing on end!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Let's show 'em what Hishi Amazon is made of!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Watch closely, Trainy!
No matter how tough the opponent, I'm gonna leave 'em in the dust!
